label: step-001
payload: Write a file called 'ledger.py' — a small accounting-ledger module, at least 100 lines long, with a module docstring and these terse-named functions, each documented: 'add_entry(book, entry)' appends an entry; 'rm_entry(book, name)' removes by name; 'tot_debits(book)' sums debit amounts; 'tot_credits(book)' sums credit amounts; 'bal(book)' returns debits minus credits. Also write 'tests/test_ledger.py' covering 'bal'.
